The solution incorrectly omitted the Jacobian factor \(g'(t)\) when substituting \(x=g(t)\). Correctly evaluating  
\[
I=\int_{-9}^{11}f(x)\,dx=\int_{-1}^{1}(9t+5)g'(t)\,dt
\]
with \(g(t)=t^{7}+6t^{5}+3t^{3}+1\) gives  
\[
I=100.
\]  

Hence the final answer 280 is wrong.  

VERDICT: REJECT (the final answer is not correct)
